Package io.github.pimak.ntfy.micronaut

Class NtfyConfiguration

java.lang.Object
io.github.pimak.ntfy.micronaut.NtfyConfiguration
@ConfigurationProperties("ntfy") public class NtfyConfiguration extends Object
Binds all ntfy.* application configuration for a Micronaut application. Micronaut's relaxed binding maps kebab-case (e.g. ntfy.app-name), camelCase and underscore variants onto these fields, and converts the Duration fields natively from strings such as 5s, 3m, 500ms or an ISO-8601 value like PT10S.

Key names, types and defaults are deliberately identical to the Spring starter's NtfyProperties, so the same ntfy.* block can be lifted from an application.yml of one framework into the other. Notably async and require-https-for-credentials both default to true, matching the engine defaults.

Getters are plain accessors and are intentionally undocumented one by one; the authoritative description of every knob lives in the project README's configuration reference.

      public String getWarnTopic()
      The ntfy topic WARN-level events are published to. Unset by default, which keeps alerting ERROR-only; a non-blank value is the entire opt-in for WARN alerting. Set it to the same value as ntfy.topic to alert on warnings through the main topic at a different priority.

    • getStartupPing

      public String getStartupPing()
      Opt-in startup self-test verifying at boot that the configured endpoint, credentials and topic actually work — instead of finding out when the first real error alert fails to deliver.
      Returns:
      "off" (default), "probe" or "publish"

    • setStartupPing

      public void setStartupPing(String startupPing)
      Selects the startup self-test mode.

      Bound as a String rather than the StartupPingMode enum on purpose: Micronaut fails bean instantiation on an unconvertible enum value, which would turn one typo in application.yml into a failed startup. The core parses it leniently and warns instead, matching every other surface.

      Parameters:
      startupPing - "off", "probe" or "publish"

    • isStartupPingFailFast

      public boolean isStartupPingFailFast()
      Whether a failed startup self-test aborts application startup instead of only warning. Enabling it also makes the self-test run inline, adding at most connect+request timeout to boot.
      Returns:
      whether to fail fast (default false)

    • setStartupPingFailFast

      public void setStartupPingFailFast(boolean startupPingFailFast)
      Turns fail-fast on a failed startup self-test on or off.
      Parameters:
      startupPingFailFast - whether a failed self-test aborts startup
